Andrew Fisher (vocals) - Alex Henery (guitar) - Ronan Crix (guitar), Duncan Stewart (bass) James Fisher (drums) 

The fourth full-length from Basement, Beside Myself is an intimate look at the drawbacks of living in your own head, and the attempt to shake off everyday anxieties. “One of the things everyone in the band seems to struggle with is living fully in the present time,” says Andrew Fisher, who co-founded the Ipswich, England-bred five-piece in 2010. “We tend to look back on the past and think, ‘That was so much better than what’s going on now,’ or look toward the future and assume it’s going to be better than today. The title came from thinking about, ‘Wouldn’t it be great if you could stop yourself from doing that, and just appreciate the moment as it happens?’” 

But for all its intense introspection and confessions of self-consciousness, Beside Myself centers on a powerful, passionately charged sound that makes every track feel deeply cathartic. A relentless burst of pure vitality, the album expresses its unrest in the language of furious guitar riffs and visceral rhythms. And at the heart of Beside Myself are Basement’s indelible melodies, an element that lends an anthemic quality to even the most heavy-hearted songs. 

The follow-up to Promise Everything—a 2016 album whose re-release the following year marked Basement’s debut for Fueled by Ramen—Beside Myself was co-produced by the band and Colin Brittain, and mixed by Rich Costey (Arctic Monkeys, Foo Fighters, Muse). As the holiday season approaches, grief can feel especially heavy. Harvest of Healing Retreat II is a compassionate space to pause, reflect, connect, and receive support as we navigate grief and transition into a new season.

Join us for a restorative day designed to honor your loss, nurture your spirit, and help you gather strength for the season ahead. Whether your loss is recent or happened long ago, this retreat is for anyone looking for a safe, supportive, and healing environment. Laverne Santangelo

WHAT TO EXPECT:

• Mindful Healing: Sound bowl healing, grief yoga, gentle movement, breathing, and restorative practices

• Supportive Connection: Guided conversations and a shared community of understanding

• Honor & Remember: A memorial altar offering an opportunity to honor your loved one(s)

• Expert Guidance: Support from therapists, grief coaches, and wellness professionals

• Practical Tools: Strategies and resources to help navigate grief through the holidays and beyond

• Continental breakfast and a light snack

• Grief support materials available for purchase, including books, affirmation cards, grief kits, and more

Registration is $50, and space is intentionally limited to help create an intimate and supportive atmosphere. 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Detroit.
